files.Title: ONIONARCH.Application.Abstractions.ConnectionFactory.IDbReadOnlyConnectionFactory
files.Summary: Creates ADO.NET connections to the read (query) database.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Application.Abstractions.ConnectionFactory.IDbWriteConnectionFactory
files.Summary: Creates ADO.NET connections to the write (command) database.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Application.Abstractions.Context.ICommandDbContext
files.Summary: Write-side port for the EF Core persistence path. Defined in Application and implemented by Persistence's CommandDbContext, so command handlers can stage and save changes without taking a dependency on EF Core types.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Application.Abstractions.Context.IQueryDbContext
files.Summary: Read-side port for the EF Core persistence path. Defined in Application and implemented by Persistence's QueryDbContext (configured for no-tracking queries).

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Application.Abstractions.IAppRequest<TResponse>
files.Summary: Base marker for anything dispatchable through . Deliberately carries no members — it exists purely so and have a single covariant type to close their generics over, regardless of whether the concrete request is a query or a command.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Application.Abstractions.ICommandHandler<TCommand, TResponse>
files.Summary: Handles a state-changing .

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Application.Abstractions.ICommandRequest<TResponse>
files.Summary: Marker for a CQRS command — a request that changes system state. Handled by an .

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Application.Abstractions.IDomainMapper<TEntity>
files.Summary: Implemented by inbound DTOs that know how to convert themselves into a domain entity.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Application.Abstractions.IPipelineBehavior<TRequest, TResponse>
files.Summary: Cross-cutting wrapper around a request/handler pair, resolved and chained by for every dispatched request regardless of its concrete type. Mirrors MediatR's IPipelineBehavior<TRequest,TResponse> shape closely enough that behaviors written for it (see ) only need their next delegate signature updated.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Application.Abstractions.IQueryHandler<TQuery, TResponse>
files.Summary: Handles a read-only .

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Application.Abstractions.IQueryRequest<TResponse>
files.Summary: Marker for a CQRS query — a request that reads data without changing system state. Handled by an .

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Application.Abstractions.IRequestHandler<TRequest, TResponse>
files.Summary: Base handler contract. always resolves the closed generic IRequestHandler<TRequest, TResponse> for the request's runtime type — it never needs to know whether the concrete request is a query or a command. and exist purely as semantic/namespace markers for handler authors and the architecture fitness tests; interface inheritance means a type implementing either of them is still discoverable here via reflection's Type.GetInterfaces().

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Application.Abstractions.ISender
files.Summary: Single dispatch chokepoint for the CQRS pipeline. Presentation depends only on this interface and on request/response contract types — never on a concrete handler — which is the same decoupling MediatR's IMediator previously provided.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Application.Abstractions.IUnitOfWork
files.Summary: Unit-of-work port over the command database. Lets Application code commit staged changes asynchronously and group multiple operations in an explicit transaction without depending on EF Core.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Application.Abstractions.IUnitOfWorkTransaction
files.Summary: An explicit database transaction started by .

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Application.Abstractions.Repositories.ISampleEntityDapperCommandRepository
files.Summary: Write-side port for the Dapper persistence path. Defined in Application, implemented in Persistence — mirrors for the EF Core path so that Application never depends on Dapper, raw SQL, or .

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Application.Abstractions.Repositories.ISampleEntityDapperQueryRepository
files.Summary: Read-side port for the Dapper persistence path. Defined in Application, implemented in Persistence — mirrors for the EF Core path so that Application never depends on Dapper, raw SQL, or .

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Application.Abstractions.Result<T>
files.Summary: Outcome of a request handler: either a successful value or an expected business-flow failure.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Application.Abstractions.ResultErrorType
files.Summary: Categorizes an expected business-flow failure carried by a . Presentation maps each category to an HTTP status code.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Application.Actions.SampleEntityDapper.Commands.CreateSampleEntityDapperRequest
files.Summary: Command to insert a new sample entity through the Dapper persistence path.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Application.Actions.SampleEntityDapper.Commands.DeleteSampleEntityDapperRequest
files.Summary: Command to delete a sample entity by key through the Dapper persistence path.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Application.Actions.SampleEntityDapper.Commands.UpdateSampleEntityDapperRequest
files.Summary: Command to update an existing sample entity through the Dapper persistence path.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Application.Actions.SampleEntityDapper.Queries.GetMultipleSampleEntityDappersRequest
files.Summary: Query to retrieve every sample entity through the Dapper persistence path.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Application.Actions.SampleEntityDapper.Queries.GetSingleSampleEntityDapperRequest
files.Summary: Query to retrieve a single sample entity by key through the Dapper persistence path.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Application.Actions.SampleEntityEFCore.Commands.CreateSampleEntityEFCoreRequest
files.Summary: Command to insert a new sample entity through the EF Core persistence path.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Application.Actions.SampleEntityEFCore.Commands.DeleteSampleEntityEFCoreRequest
files.Summary: Command to delete a sample entity through the EF Core persistence path.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Application.Actions.SampleEntityEFCore.Commands.UpdateSampleEntityEFCoreRequest
files.Summary: Command to update an existing sample entity through the EF Core persistence path.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Application.Actions.SampleEntityEFCore.Queries.GetMultipleSampleEntityEFCoresRequest
files.Summary: Query to retrieve every sample entity through the EF Core persistence path.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Application.Actions.SampleEntityEFCore.Queries.GetSingleSampleEntityEFCoreRequest
files.Summary: Query to retrieve a single sample entity by key through the EF Core persistence path.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Application.Behaviors.LoggingBehavior<TRequest, TResponse>
files.Summary: Logs entry, successful completion, and failure of every command/query. Combined with the ambient correlation-ID logging scope pushed by CorrelationIdMiddleware (Infrastructure), this reconstructs the full "path" of a request through the CQRS pipeline without any handler needing to know a correlation ID exists.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Application.Contracts.Dtos.CreateSampleRequestDto
files.Summary: Inbound payload for creating a sample entity.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Application.Contracts.Dtos.SampleDtoRecord
files.Summary: Outbound representation of a sample entity returned to API callers.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Application.Contracts.Dtos.UpdateSampleRequestDto
files.Summary: Inbound payload for updating an existing sample entity.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Application.DependencyInjection
files.Summary: Composition-root extensions that register the Application layer's services.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Domain.Abstractions.Entity
files.Summary: Abstract base class for every persistable domain entity.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Domain.Abstractions.IBaseOptionsConfig
files.Summary: Contract for strongly typed options classes that are bound from a named configuration section.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Domain.Abstractions.IEntity
files.Summary: Marker interface identifying a type as a domain entity.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Domain.Entities.SampleEntityDefinition
files.Summary: Sample domain entity used to demonstrate both the EF Core and Dapper persistence paths end to end. Replace or extend it with real entities when building on this template.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Infrastructure.Correlation.CorrelationIdAccessor
files.Summary: Ambient accessor for the current operation's correlation ID, backed by AsyncLocal so the value flows implicitly through the entire async call chain of a single request — every downstream await, request handler, and repository call sees it without it being passed as a parameter anywhere.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Infrastructure.Correlation.CorrelationIdMiddleware
files.Summary: ASP.NET Core middleware that establishes a correlation ID for every HTTP request.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Infrastructure.DependencyInjection
files.Summary: Composition-root extensions that register and wire up the Infrastructure layer's cross-cutting services (health checks, logging, correlation IDs, problem details).

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Infrastructure.Exceptions.GlobalExceptionHandler
files.Summary: Centralized handler for unhandled exceptions in every web host. Logs the exception and returns an RFC 7807 500 response that includes the request's correlation ID, without leaking exception details to the caller.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Infrastructure.HealthChecks.HealthCheckConfiguration
files.Summary: Formats health check results for the /health endpoint.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Infrastructure.HealthChecks.SimpleHealthCheck
files.Summary: Demonstration health check that randomly reports Unhealthy, Degraded, or Healthy so the /health endpoint's output for each status can be observed. Replace the code between the Start/End markers with a real probe (database, downstream service, etc.).

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Infrastructure.Versioning.ApplicationVersion
files.Summary: The application's semantic version, read once from the assembly metadata that MinVer stamps at build time (see Directory.Build.props).

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Persistence.ConnectionFactory.DbReadOnlyConnectionFactory
files.Summary: Creates connections to the query database using and the configured query-side .

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Persistence.ConnectionFactory.DbWriteConnectionFactory
files.Summary: Creates connections to the command database using and the configured command-side .

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Persistence.Contexts.BaseDbContext<T>
files.Summary: Shared EF Core model for the command and query contexts. Declare entity sets here so both sides of the CQRS split map the same schema.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Persistence.Contexts.CommandDbContext
files.Summary: EF Core context for the write side. Implements both and , and both are resolved to the same scoped instance so they share change tracking within a request.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Persistence.Contexts.QueryDbContext
files.Summary: EF Core context for the read side, configured for no-tracking queries.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Persistence.DependencyInjection
files.Summary: Composition-root extensions that register the Persistence layer: configuration options, the database provider for each side of the CQRS split, and both the Dapper and EF Core implementations of the Application-layer persistence ports.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Persistence.Options.ConnectionStringOptions
files.Summary: Connection strings for the query and command databases, bound from the ConnectionStrings configuration section.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Persistence.Options.DatabasePlatformOptions
files.Summary: Selects the database platform for each side of the CQRS split, bound from the DatabasePlatform configuration section. Supported values (case-insensitive): MSSQL, POSTGRESQL, MYSQL.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Persistence.Providers.IDatabaseProvider
files.Summary: Abstracts a database platform (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) so the EF Core and Dapper paths can be pointed at any supported platform through configuration alone.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Persistence.Providers.MySQLDatabaseProvider
files.Summary: for MySQL. Uses the MySql.EntityFrameworkCore provider for EF Core and MySqlConnector for Dapper connections.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Persistence.Providers.PostgreSqlDatabaseProvider
files.Summary: for PostgreSQL, using Npgsql for both EF Core and Dapper connections.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Persistence.Providers.SqlServerDatabaseProvider
files.Summary: for Microsoft SQL Server, using Microsoft.Data.SqlClient for both EF Core and Dapper connections.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Persistence.Repositories.SampleEntityDapperCommandRepository
files.Summary: Dapper implementation of , executing parameterized SQL against the SampleTable table in the command database.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Persistence.Repositories.SampleEntityDapperQueryRepository
files.Summary: Dapper implementation of , executing parameterized SQL against the SampleTable table in the query database.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Presentation.API.ApiAssemblyMarker
files.Summary: Marker type identifying the Presentation.API assembly. Gives integration tests a stable, explicitly named entry-point type argument for WebApplicationFactory<TEntryPoint> without depending on the compiler-generated Program class from top-level statements.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Presentation.API.Controllers.SampleController
files.Summary: Sample CRUD endpoints exposing the same operations over both persistence paths: api/Sample/EFCore/... and api/Sample/Dapper/....

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Presentation.API.Extensions.ResultExtensions
files.Summary: Maps Application-layer values to MVC s so controllers share one consistent status-code mapping.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Presentation.Console.Worker
files.Summary: Sample background worker for the console host. Once per second it starts a new unit of work with its own correlation ID and logs a heartbeat inside a correlation ID logging scope.

files.Title: ONIONARCH.Presentation.Web.WebAssemblyMarker
files.Summary: Marker type identifying the Presentation.Web assembly, for use wherever a type reference to this assembly is needed (for example WebApplicationFactory<TEntryPoint> or assembly scanning).
